sentences.text: Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vinod S. Bhardwaj.

* * * *
Present: Mr. Sunil Sihag, Advocate
 for the applicant-petitioner.

The main petition had been filed for seeking issuance of directions to respondent No.1 to conduct fair and impartial enquiry/investigation in FIR No.249 dated 29.12.2022 (Annexure P-1) under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 409 and 120-B of I.P.C registered at Police Station Bichhor, District Nuh.
Instant application has been filed for seeking withdrawal of the main petition, which is now fixed for hearing on 20.11.2023.
The application is duly supported by an affidavit of the petitioner himself.
Mr. Vivek Saini, Addl. A.G., Haryana accepts notice has no objection to the application being allowed.
Accordingly, the application is allowed and the hearing of the main case is preponed and the same is taken on the Board today itself.
In view of the application seeking withdrawal of the main writ petition, which is supported by an affidavit of the petitioner, the main writ petition stands disposed of as withdrawn.
